Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY DILG Legal Opinion No. 61 s. 2011 September 26, 2011 DATU KHADAFY DILANGALEN BMO Municipal Administrator Labangan, Zamboanga del Sur Dear Mr. Biao: This has reference to your request for this Department to direct our Regional Office and the municipality's depository bank to recognize your authority as municipal administrator and your supposed authority to "disburse/draw checks in payment of the obligations of the municipality as clearly outlined in Section 345 of the Local Government Code" This request is anchored on the fact that, based on your representations, the Acting Mayor has never assumed office since the time of Mayor \fVilson Nandang's suspension, up to this time. In reply to your request, please be informed that section 345 of the Local Government Code of 1991 is rather clear, which needs no further elucidation, viz: Section 345. Officials Authorized to Draw Checks in Settlement of Obligations. - Checks in obligations shall be drawn by the local treasurer and countersiqned by the local administrator. In case of temporary absence or incapacity of the foregoing officials, these duties shall devolve upon their immediate assistants. (underscoring ours) Clearly, the authority to draw checks for the settlement of obligations is vested with the Local Treasurer and not with the Municipal Administrator. Your duty to countersign the checks drawn should not be perceived as an authority to draw the said checks. As regards disbursement of the local funds, Section 470 (d) (3) of RA 7160 provides: (d) The treasurer shall take charge of the treasury office, perform the duties provided for under Book II of this Code, and shall: -xxx- (3) Take charge of the disbursement of all local government funds and such other funds the custody of which may be entrusted to him by law or other competent authority; (underscored for emphasis) -xxx-

-2- Ergo, it is rather patent that the law has vested the power to disburse funds with the Local Treasurer and not with your office. Hence, it is wise to advise you to closely coordinate with your local treasurer for the unhampered flow of your disbursements to pay the salaries of your employees as you put it. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, STERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary DIR. PAISAL O. ABUTAZIL, CESO SSS Pajares Ave., San Francisco District Pagadian City LS:87/11
